clips.text: Negative attitudes negate life - they are good for dying but not good for living.
Life needs positive attitudes; life feeds on them because they make you not only happy but creative also.

Once there lived an old woman, but the older she became the younger she felt - because youthfulness has nothing to do with age, it is an attitude, and with age and its richness one can really be younger than the young.
The old woman was so cheerful and creative that everyone wondered at her.
But you must have some clouds in your life, said a visitor.
Why, of course: if there were no clouds where would the blessed showers come from?
In the presence of trouble - and there are troubles in life - the positive mind grows wings but others buy crutches.
